tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swasti/ /tshe lus gcig gis rdo rje 'chang gi sa//

bgrod par nus pa'i rmad byung lam po che// gdul byar rjes su ston mkhas 'dren pa mchog/ bka' brgyud gser ri'i phreng bar gus pas btud// de la spyir nges don gyi mdo rgyud bstan bcos zab mo rnams la thos bsam gnang ba'i skabs dang*/ lhag par dam chos phyag rgya chen po'am/ zab mo nā ro chos drug sogs nyams bzhes skabs/ chos sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang nas bzung rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byon pa'i bka' brgyud kyi bla ma gser ri'i phreng ba lta bu rnams la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa dang yid ches mos gus khyad par can zhig yod dgos pa dang*/ de yang cal sgrogs rjes 'jug gi rmongs dad tsam ma yin par/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang*/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i phrin las rnams ji lta ba bzhin du shes nas/ yid ches bzlog tu med pa'i dad gus khyad par du 'phags pa zhig bskyed dgos la/ de bskyed pa'i rgyu ni bka' brgyud gser phreng gi rnam thar shes pa la rag las pa'i phyir/ gser phreng gi rnam thar mjal rgyu ni shin tu gal che zhing*/ de yang bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar mang du bzhugs pa las/ si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas dang*/ be lo tshe dbang kun khyab bla slob kyis mdzad pa'i gser phreng gi rnam thar zla ba chu shel gyi phreng ba 'di khyad par du 'phags par bzhugs mod/ 'on kyang bka' 'bum gyi khrod du par bskrun gnang ba tsam las zur du med par brten/ dpe cha ba rnams ni dpal 'byor gyi rgyab rten la de tsam do snang mi gnang ba kho na yin stabs de rnams kyis bka' 'bum cha tshang blu yon zhu ba'am/ bka' 'bum las zur du bton dgos na stabs ma bde zhing*/ grwa rkyang bya bral ba de dag ni mkhas pa dang grub thob 'byung ba'i chu mgo lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ de dag la zhabs zhus 'grub pa'i re bas bka' 'bum las zur du deb gzugs su par bskrun zhus lags pa dang*/

lhag par si tu chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis phyag bstar gnang ba'i gser phreng gi zhal thang kun gyi 'dren byed du gyur pa tsam gyis yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog pa zhig bzhugs pa kar shod lha bris pa rnams kyis ga shog gi lam nas dpe bshus byas pa zhig sangs rgyas mnyan pa sku phreng dgu pa bod nas bros phebs skabs sku ngal la ma 'dzem par gdan 'dren zhus nas rum bteg bshad sgrub chos 'khor gling la phul ba de nyid/ phyis su rgyal ba'i dbang po rang byung rig pa'i rdo rjes rgya bal sogs su bstan pa'i me ro gso ba'i phrin las bskyang ba'i skabs/ si tu chos 'byung las phyis su byon pa'i gser phreng na rim gyi zhal thang kha bskang ba'i tshe/ zur mang lha bris bkra rgyal nas bstan pa la phan pa'i lhag bsam kho nas kha bskang gi zhal thang cha tshang bris nas phul ba bcas bzhugs yod kyang*/ kha shas kyis lha ngo ji bzhin mi mkhyen pa dang*/ yang gtso bo tsam ngos zin kyang*/ 'khor rnams zhal mi 'tsho ba sogs yod pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du/ rnam thar dang zhal thang lhan du bzhugs pa 'di nyid par bskrun zhu skabs/ rdor slob bstan dga' rin po ches gser phreng zhal thang gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi mtshan byang gces nyar gnang ba g.yar po bka' drin byung bas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ rang slob nub ri'i grwa lha bris pa karma dgra 'dul gyis ang gi dang mtshan byang bris yul/ ri mo bris shing*/ bshad grwa'i dpe khrid pa tshe ring gis gang spyir gra 'grigs gnang ba dang*/ the wan du bzhugs pa'i rang dgon gyi bla ma karma tshe dbang gis par bskrun gyi sbyin bdag gnang ba bcas kyi mthun rkyen la brten nas deb 'di par bskrun zhus thub pa la thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang*/ da lam rig mdzod du bcug skabs nyams myong dman pa sogs kyis zhan cha byung ba khag mkhas dbang rnams la bshags shing*/ bka' bslab sogs lhug stsol bka' drin zhu/
